html: Knee replacement surgery replaces damaged parts of the knee joint with metal and plastic parts. It is most often done for severe arthritis pain that has not improved with other treatments.

image.caption: Physical therapy is a key part of recovery.
image.title: Illustration of a knee joint

html:
• Knee pain that limits walking or climbing stairs
  • Pain at rest, day or night
  • Stiffness or swelling that has not responded to medicine, therapy or injections
Most people walk with help the day of or after surgery. Physical therapy continues for several weeks. Full recovery can take several months.
